statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, c*(X:ℝ)*M X ≤ ∑ n ∈ E X, (H X n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 平方根步长窗口内的一阶矩下界
plain_statement.en: Lower-bound total arrivals with a square-root-scale first prime

brief.zh: 用素数定理分别估计矩形的两边。只控制路径总量，允许部分偶数没有路径。
brief.en: Apply interval prime counts to each side of the interior rectangle. This total permits missed endpoints.
